d: The Assistant Manager of Admissions and Student Funding is responsible for the accurate execution of the university's admissions and student funding processes. The role ensures the timely and accurate processing of applications, supports the administration of scholarships and financial assistance, and provides guidance to prospective and current students and their families. The Assistant Manager works closely with the Senior Manager of Admissions and Student Funding to ensure compliance with university policies, maintain service excellence, support enrollment objectives, and facilitate the effective implementation of admissions and student funding initiatives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Education, Business Administration, or a related field
3-5 years of experience in admissions, student recruitment, or related higher education roles
Supervisory or team coordination experience preferred
Student-focused approach with strong customer service orientation
Proficiency in data management and admissions systems (e.g., CRM)
Ability to work effectively in a team and cross-departmental environment
r: Assist in managing day-to-day admissions operations, ensuring timely processing of applications
Guide prospective students and families through the admissions process with accurate and timely information
Review applications and support admission decisions in line with university policies
Support with enrollment events, roadshows and school visits
Assist in training, supervising, and mentoring admissions staff
Collaborate with academic and administrative departments in terms of evaluating credit transfer cases as well as special needs cases
Maintain accurate student records and ensure data integrity in the admissions system
Coordinate the administration of scholarships, discounts, and student funding schemes, ensuring applications are reviewed and processed in accordance with university policies and eligibility criteria

Maintain accurate student funding records, monitor scholarship recipients' eligibility and academic progress, and coordinate with relevant departments to ensure the effective implementation of approved awards
Assist in monitoring scholarship budgets and preparing funding reports, handling student inquiries and appeals, and updating student funding procedures and manuals
Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the Senior management

d: We are seeking a proactive and organised Customer Service Officer to support logistics and delivery operations within the Supply Chain team. The role is responsible for coordinating daily deliveries between customers, drivers, dispatchers, and logistics personnel, ensuring efficient truck utilisation, timely deliveries, and excellent customer communication.
The successful candidate will monitor vehicle movements, confirm customer readiness before dispatch, manage delivery exceptions, and support continuous improvement of logistics performance.
q: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
Proven experience in customer service, logistics operations, logistics coordination, or a similar role.
Knowledge of logistics operations, transportation processes, and inventory management principles.
Good customer service and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to communicate effectively with customers, drivers, vendors, and internal teams.
High attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping.
Ability to manage priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
Understanding of health and safety practices within logistics and warehouse operations.
Proficiency in tracking, reporting, and monitoring operational performance.
r: Monitor daily truck movements through GPS tracking systems.
Track departures, arrivals, unloading activities, and truck returns.
Identify delayed, stationary, or route-deviating vehicles.
Follow up with drivers regarding delays and operational issues.
Escalate significant delays, breakdowns, or route issues to relevant stakeholders.
Monitor delivery trips against agreed turnaround times.
Maintain records of delays and recurring issues.
Analyse delay trends and recommend corrective actions to improve fleet utilisation.
Contact customers prior to dispatch to confirm delivery readiness.
Verify storage and silo capacity before releasing deliveries.
Confirm delivery schedules and manage postponement requests.
Communicate customer requirements and restrictions to logistics teams.
Prevent unnecessary dispatches to customers unable to receive deliveries.
Serve as the primary coordination point between customers, drivers, dispatchers, and logistics teams.
Keep customers informed of delivery schedules and significant delays.
Communicate customer instructions and delivery requirements to drivers.
Assist in resolving delivery-related customer concerns.
Support execution of daily dispatch and delivery plans.
Coordinate truck availability with delivery schedules.
Follow up on delayed, postponed, and rescheduled deliveries.
Support optimisation of truck allocation and utilisation.
Coordinate with Operations, Sales, Maintenance, and third-party logistics providers regarding delivery issues.
Ensure delivery documentation and trip records are maintained accurately.
Proactively identify issues affecting delivery performance, including vehicle breakdowns, unloading delays, storage limitations, and driver availability.
Take immediate action to minimise disruption.
Escalate unresolved issues to the Logistics Supervisor or Manager.
Maintain logs of exceptions, delays, and corrective actions.
Prepare daily and weekly logistics reports covering:
Identify recurring issues and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement.
